detailed_findings.ai_passport_ocr: ✅ WORKING - Backend reads passport images with Emergent LLM (GPT-5.4 vision), extracts fields (first_name, last_name, passport_no, birth_date, passport_expiry, gender, nationality), returns confidence score. PDF files return graceful error (ok:false, reason:'pdf'). Unknown file_id returns 404.
detailed_findings.seo_blog_articles: ✅ WORKING - Public endpoints /api/articles (list) and /api/articles/:slug (detail with related) return DB-backed articles. Frontend pages /gelismeler and /gelismeler/:slug render with breadcrumbs, canonical/OG meta tags, and Article JSON-LD schema.
detailed_findings.admin_testimonials_crud: ✅ WORKING - Admin can create, update, delete testimonials via /admin/yorumlar. Published testimonials appear in /api/content/site. Review summary can be updated. Frontend renders review summary card and testimonials list.
detailed_findings.admin_articles_crud: ✅ WORKING - Admin can create, update, delete articles via /admin/yazilar. Slug auto-generated from Turkish title (e.g. 'Dubai Vizesi Nasıl Alınır?' -> dubai-vizesi-nasil-alinir). Unpublished articles return 404 on public endpoint. Frontend renders articles list with edit/delete buttons.
detailed_findings.admin_whatsapp_notification: ✅ WORKING - POST /admin/applications/:id/whatsapp generates wa.me link with prefilled Turkish message. Phone normalized from 05xx to 905xx format. Returns 400 when application has no phone, 404 for unknown application. Logs to notifications collection. Frontend button exists in admin application detail (data-testid='send-visa-whatsapp-button').
detailed_findings.sample_visa_section: ✅ WORKING - Home page renders sample visa section (data-testid='sample-visa-document') with /ornek-vize.jpg image (187KB, loads successfully). UAE flag icons present.
detailed_findings.db_backed_content: ✅ WORKING - /api/content/site returns testimonials, review_summary, and articles from MongoDB collections instead of hardcoded constants. Seeded on startup if empty.
detailed_findings.regression_tests: ✅ PASSED - Full application creation (multi-traveler), Stripe checkout, admin login/list/detail, visa PDF upload/send all working. Dark mode toggle not tested but code exists.
